class.name: MMCurveFeature
class.brief_description: A [MMFeature] that matches a named value set by the game, such as movement speed, stance or foot phase.
class.description: One dimension. At runtime the value is read from [member MMCharacter.feature_values] using [member curve_name] as the key. When baking, the value of each pose is read from the first source that exists in the animation: - A value or Bezier track at [member track_path], sampled at the pose's time. Use this when the value changes during a clip, for example the speed in a long motion capture take. - The animation's metadata named [member curve_name], for a value that is constant for the whole clip. - [member default_value]. For example, to keep walking input on walking clips and running input on running clips, set [member curve_name] to [code]speed[/code], give each clip a [code]speed[/code] value, and set [code]feature_values["speed"][/code] to the speed the player asks for.

members.member: Key of the value in [member MMCharacter.feature_values], and name of the animation metadata used when there is no track.
Value used for animations without the track or the metadata, and at runtime when [member MMCharacter.feature_values] has no entry for [member curve_name].
Path of a value or Bezier track in the animations, for example [code]MotionCurves:speed[/code]. Leave empty to use metadata only.
